text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haa!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (The February Stakes! Which one will show up? Falcon, or Espoir...?)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(No matter which one shows up, this will be...
a clash between Funabashi and the Central new generation...!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaah!

With the confrontation against a familiar rival
drawing closer by the day, Furioso desperately
suppresses her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... No matter how much I owe them,
...it doesn't matter...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Overpower them...! Espoir-san...
Falcon-san... or maybe even both...

Just who will step forward?
And finally—the day of the race entrant announcement arrived.
The one who announced their entry into the February Stakes was—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey there, I'm Transcend.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
First, as a member of the new generation,
how about I be the one to challenge Furi-o?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Tran-san...

Transcend is also on good terms with Furioso,
as well as a benefactor who provided valuable information.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, as for the race predictions
so far... let's see...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“The champion-class Furioso holds an overwhelming advantage.”
Hmm, hmm, I see...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Well, if that's the case,
I guess I can take it easy."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If nobody's marking me, I can run however I like.
Pretty much the ideal scenario~

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.

It was the first time we were in the position of being challenged.
That was unfamiliar territory for us...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: As the defending champion, this is a battle Furioso absolutely cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If we put on a poor showing against the newcomers,
people might think, 'As expected of regional racing...'

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Right... If I run poorly here,
all the work I put into Funabashi's image will...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it... I'll show you I can...
No matter what it takes...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So this is what it feels like... on the receiving end...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Yeah... It's heavy. Far too heavy...
Yeah... It's heavy, far too heavy...

text_block_list.text: However, the champions of the Central races, including Crimson Nova, have always delivered results while constantly feeling this immense pressure.

Her mental strength is formidable.
No, it goes beyond merely formidable...
choice_data_list: So these are the incredible Uma Musume...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That is... true...
You're... right...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No! But still! They are the enemy.
We must not dull our spearhead!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No matter how magnificent the opponent may be...
No matter how close of an Umamusume friend they might be...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I mustn't empathize.
For us who marched in from Funabashi,
retreat is not an option...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat the JRA. Until I get my revenge
at the milestone Diolite Kinen!"
And on the day of the February Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Furi-chan, don't you lose!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Funabashi is the strongest!! Heave-ho, heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...
Furioso, I've got intel on you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Sounds like she's really worn down mentally, like, a lot.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Tran-san...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, not like I'm planning to take advantage of your weakness or anything, though~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There's stuff I wanna do too,
once I proudly make it past this hurdle.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, with that said,
good luck to us both.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ugh...
A lighthearted challenge. Yet, it placed a greater pressure on Furioso than anyone could imagine.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I'll do it. I'll show them.
I'll strike down any challenger, and then—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
On to the next Diolite Kinen.
We must settle our fateful score no matter what!
